repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI 是一个功能丰富的自托管 AI 平台，支持 Ollama 和 OpenAI API，内置 RAG 推理引擎，提供插件扩展、多用户权限管理、响应式设计、PWA 移动端体验、语音视频通话、模型构建器及原生 Python 函数调用等核心功能，适用于离线部署与 AI 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a feature-rich, self-hosted AI platform supporting Ollama and OpenAI APIs, with built-in RAG inference engine, plugin extensibility, granular user permissions, responsive PWA design, voice/video calls, model builder, and native Python function calling for offline AI deployment and application development.

repos.description: The Web framework for perfectionists with deadlines.
repos.summary_zh: Django 是一个高级 Python Web 框架，专为追求高效开发流程的务实开发者设计。它提供开箱即用的功能，支持快速构建安全、可维护的 Web 应用，内置 ORM、管理后台、认证系统和 URL 路由等核心组件，极大提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Django is a high-level Python web framework designed for developers who value rapid development and clean, pragmatic design. It provides built-in features like ORM, admin interface, authentication, and URL routing, enabling secure and maintainable web application development with minimal boilerplate code.

repos.description: :tada: A magical vue admin                                                                https://panjiachen.github.io/vue-element-admin
repos.summary_zh: vue-element-admin 是一个基于 Vue 2.6+ 和 Element UI 2.7+ 的现代化企业级后台管理系统解决方案，提供国际化支持、权限管理、数据可视化等完整功能，支持快速搭建复杂单页应用，适用于中大型管理后台开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-element-admin is a production-ready front-end solution for admin interfaces built on Vue 2.6+ and Element UI 2.7+. It features i18n support, role-based permissions, dashboard widgets, and enterprise-grade templates to accelerate development of complex single-page applications.

repos.description: ✨ Zero-config AI chat assistant. No API key needed — sign up and instantly chat with GPT-5, Claude 4, Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek & 100+ top models. Pay-as-you-go saves you more. Available on Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, Windows.
repos.summary_zh: NextChat 是一款轻量级、高性能的 AI 助手应用，支持 Web、iOS、macOS、Android、Linux 和 Windows 全平台。它集成了 Claude、DeepSeek、GPT-4 和 Gemini Pro 等多种 AI 模型，提供现代化的用户界面和强大的功能，包括 MCP 支持、企业级私有化部署、知识库集成和权限管理，适用于个人用户和企业客户。
repos.summary_en: NextChat is a lightweight and fast AI assistant supporting Web, iOS, macOS, Android, Linux, and Windows. It integrates multiple AI models including Claude, DeepSeek, GPT-4, and Gemini Pro. Featuring modern UI, MCP support, enterprise-grade private deployment, knowledge base integration, and admin panel with permission controls.

repos.description: Independent technology for modern publishing, memberships, subscriptions and newsletters.
repos.summary_zh: Ghost 是一个现代化的开源 Node.js 内容管理系统（CMS），专为独立创作者、会员订阅和新闻通讯设计。它提供强大的发布工具、会员管理和订阅功能，支持无头架构，可灵活集成前端框架。核心优势包括简洁的编辑器、SEO 优化、自动化工作流和 Ghost(Pro) 托管服务，适合个人博客、媒体网站及内容变现平台。
repos.summary_en: Ghost is a modern, open-source Node.js CMS designed for professional publishing, memberships, subscriptions, and newsletters. It offers a clean editor, SEO tools, and headless architecture for flexible front-end integration. With features like automated workflows and Ghost(Pro) managed hosting, it's ideal for creators and publishers seeking a developer-friendly, scalable platform.

repos.description: Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework in Python with WebUI, tools, memory, MCP, multi-agent workflows, automation, and chat apps
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是一个超轻量级个人 AI 助手，灵感来自 OpenClaw，核心功能仅约 4,000 行代码，比 Clawdbot 缩小 99%。支持多平台通信（Slack、Discord、Feishu、DingTalk 等）、MCP 协议、多模态文件处理及智能会话管理，具备高可靠性与模块化扩展能力，适用于个人自动化与智能交互场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an ultra-lightweight personal AI assistant inspired by OpenClaw, delivering core agent functionality in just ~4,000 lines of code—99% smaller than Clawdbot. It supports multi-platform messaging (Slack, Discord, Feishu, etc.), MCP protocol, multimodal file handling, and robust session management, offering high reliability and modular extensibility for personal automation and intelligent interaction.

repos.description: A visual no-code/code-free web crawler/spider易采集：一个可视化浏览器自动化测试/数据采集/网页爬虫软件，可以无代码图形化的设计和执行爬虫任务。别名：ServiceWrapper面向Web应用的智能化服务封装系统。
repos.summary_zh: 易采集/EasySpider 是一款完全免费的视觉无代码浏览器自动化工具，支持图形化设计爬虫任务，无需编程即可实现网页数据采集与自动化测试。通过可视化操作选择网页元素，自动识别同类内容并批量采集，同时支持命令行模式嵌入其他系统，适用于电商、数据抓取等场景。
repos.summary_en: EasySpider is a completely free visual no-code web crawler and browser automation tool that enables users to design and execute data collection tasks through a graphical interface without programming. It automatically detects similar elements on web pages, supports batch data extraction, and can also run via command line for integration into other systems, ideal for e-commerce scraping and automation testing.

repos.description: A next.js web application that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams. This app allows you to create, modify, and enhance diagrams through natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization.
repos.summary_zh: Next AI Draw.io 是一个基于 Next.js 的 AI 驱动图表设计工具，通过自然语言指令与 AI 辅助可视化，支持创建、修改和增强 draw.io 风格的流程图与架构图，集成多模态 AI 能力与云服务商图标库。
repos.summary_en: Next AI Draw.io is a Next.js-based web app that integrates AI capabilities with draw.io diagrams, enabling users to create, modify, and enhance diagrams via natural language commands and AI-assisted visualization, featuring multi-cloud icon support and real-time diagram generation.

repos.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: QwenPaw 是一款个人 AI 助手，支持本地或云端部署，数据完全自主可控。内置日程管理、文档处理等技能，支持多智能体协作与自定义扩展，兼容多种聊天平台，易于安装与集成。
repos.summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant that can be deployed locally or in the cloud, ensuring full data control. It features built-in skills like scheduling and document processing, supports multi-agent collaboration and extensible custom skills, and integrates with multiple chat platforms.

repos.description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
repos.summary_zh: AionUi 是一款免费、开源的 AI 协作者应用，支持 24/7 自动化，内置多 AI 智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Qwen Code 等），提供跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）本地运行、零配置启动、远程访问（WebUI/Telegram/Lark）和任务调度功能，适用于代码开发、文件处理与自动化工作流。
repos.summary_en: AionUi is a free, open-source AI coworking app that enables 24/7 automation with built-in multi-agent support (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw, Qwen Code). It offers zero-setup local execution, cross-platform compatibility, remote access via WebUI/Telegram, and scheduled task automation for coding, file operations, and workflow management.

repos.description: A UI library by WeChat official design team, includes the most useful widgets/modules in mobile web applications.
repos.summary_zh: WeUI 是腾讯微信官方设计团队打造的开源 UI 库，专为微信小程序和 Web 应用设计，提供丰富的移动端组件（如按钮、表单、弹窗等），确保与微信生态一致的用户体验，支持快速构建美观、标准化的移动 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: WeUI is an open-source UI library developed by Tencent's WeChat design team, specifically tailored for WeChat web and mini-program development. It offers a comprehensive set of mobile-first components (e.g., buttons, forms, dialogs) to deliver a consistent and standardized user experience across WeChat ecosystems, enabling rapid development of visually appealing mobile web apps.

repos.description: 全面ESM+Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript编写的一款后台管理系统（兼容移动端）
repos.summary_zh: vue-pure-admin 是一款基于 ESM 规范的现代化中后台管理系统模板，采用 Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript 技术栈构建，支持移动端适配。提供完整的前端架构与组件库，包含国际化精简版本，打包体积优化至350KB以下，配套详细文档与视频教程，支持 Docker 部署与 Gitpod 在线开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-pure-admin is a modern admin template built with ESM standard, using Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript stack. It supports mobile adaptation, offers complete frontend architecture and component library, includes i18n thin version with optimized bundle size under 350KB, and provides comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, Docker support, and Gitpod integration.

repos.description: Share your terminal as a web application
repos.summary_zh: GoTTY 是一个将命令行工具转换为 Web 应用的轻量级工具，支持通过浏览器远程访问终端会话。它提供端口监听、TLS 加密、基础认证、随机 URL 生成等安全特性，适用于运维、开发调试和远程协作场景。
repos.summary_en: GoTTY is a lightweight CLI tool that transforms command-line tools into web-based applications, enabling remote terminal access via browsers. It supports secure features like TLS encryption, basic authentication, random URL generation, and dynamic resizing for use in operations, debugging, and remote collaboration.

repos.description: Mobile UI Components based on Vue & WeUI
repos.summary_zh: Vux 是基于 Vue 2.3+ 和 WeUI 构建的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的微信风格组件与交互效果。支持 webpack 构建，集成数据绑定与事件处理，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用，兼容主流移动浏览器。
repos.summary_en: Vux is a mobile UI component library built on Vue 2.3+ and WeUI, offering rich WeChat-style components and interactions. It supports webpack build, data binding, and event handling, ideal for rapid mobile web app development with broad browser compatibility.

repos.description: Create web-based user interfaces with Python. The nice way.
repos.summary_zh: NiceGUI是一个基于Python的轻量级Web UI框架，通过纯Python代码快速构建按钮、图表、3D场景等交互界面。内置热重载、定时器刷新与数据绑定，支持浏览器访问与原生桌面模式，适用于仪表板、机器人控制和ML调参等场景。
repos.summary_en: NiceGUI is a lightweight Python-based framework for building interactive web UIs with buttons, charts, and 3D scenes. It features auto-reload, timers, data binding, and supports both browser and desktop modes—ideal for dashboards, robotics, and ML tuning.

repos.description: 最接近原生APP体验的高性能框架
repos.summary_zh: mui 是一个专为移动端 HTML5 应用设计的高性能框架，有效解决了浏览器原生体验差的问题，如白屏、动画卡顿、下拉刷新不流畅等。它提供接近原生 APP 的流畅交互与丰富 UI 控件，支持与 HBuilder 开发工具深度集成，显著提升移动端 Web 应用开发效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: mui is a high-performance framework for mobile HTML5 apps, addressing core issues like page flickering, poor animations, and unsmooth pull-to-refresh. It delivers near-native app experiences with rich UI components and seamless integration with HBuilder, enabling efficient development of smooth, visually appealing mobile web applications.

repos.description: Essential UI blocks for building mobile web apps.
repos.summary_zh: Ant Design Mobile 是构建移动端 Web 应用的核心 UI 组件库，提供高性能、可定制的原子化组件，支持 CSS 变量主题定制与流畅动画，适用于快速开发跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: Ant Design Mobile is a core UI component library for building mobile web apps, offering high-performance, customizable atomic components with CSS variable theming and smooth animations for cross-platform mobile development.

repos.description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available on desktop and the web.
repos.summary_zh: Ekko Studio 是一款本地优先的 AI 工作空间，支持多代理实时协作、可视化工作流构建与编码任务。集成 Hermes、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理运行时，提供桌面端、Web 控制台与 Docker 部署方案，适用于开发者与团队的高效 AI 协作场景。
repos.summary_en: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace supporting multi-agent collaboration, visual workflow building, and coding tasks. It integrates Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and other mainstream AI agent runtimes, offering desktop app, web console and Docker deployment options for developer and team efficiency.

repos.description: Ekko Studio is a local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows, available on desktop and the web.
repos.summary_zh: Hermes Studio 是 Hermes Agent 的全功能本地控制平面，提供跨平台 AI 聊天、会话管理、定时任务与用量分析。支持 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等 8 大平台统一配置，内置文件浏览器、Web 终端、语音交互与编码代理运行器。以桌面应用、npm CLI 和 Docker 镜像三种形式分发，所有数据本地存储于 SQLite，确保隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Hermes Studio is a comprehensive local control plane for Hermes Agent, delivering multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics. It unifies configuration across 8 platforms including Telegram, Discord, and Slack, with built-in file browsing, web terminal, voice I/O, and coding agent runners. Distributed as a desktop app, npm CLI package, and Docker image, all data stays local via SQLite storage.

repos.description: Practice English, one strike, one step forward
repos.summary_zh: TypeWords 是一款开源英语单词与文章练习工具，基于 Nuxt 构建。支持跟读、听写、自测、默写等多种模式，内置 CET-4/6、雅思、托福等主流词库，通过艾宾浩斯记忆曲线智能规划学习，提供双语对照与发音跟读，界面简洁无广告，数据本地存储。
repos.summary_en: TypeWords is an open-source English vocabulary and article practice tool built with Nuxt. It supports follow-along, dictation, self-test, and memory typing modes, with built-in word banks for CET-4/6, IELTS, TOEFL and more. Features spaced repetition algorithms, bilingual comparison, pronunciation playback, and a clean ad-free interface with local data storage.

repos.description: 🧑‍🚀 全世界最好的LLM资料总结（多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练、模型推理、o1 模型、MCP、小语言模型、视觉语言模型） | Summary of the world's best LLM resources.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是全网最全面的大语言模型（LLM）资源汇总，涵盖多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练与推理等全链路技术方向，持续更新维护，为研究者与开发者提供权威的一站式学习与实践指南。
repos.summary_en: This repository is the most comprehensive collection of LLM resources globally, covering multimodal generation, agents, code assistance, AI review, data processing, model training and inference, and more. It serves as an authoritative one-stop guide for researchers and developers, continuously updated.

repos.description: Web dashboard for Hermes Agent — multi-platform AI chat, session management, scheduled jobs, usage analytics
repos.summary_zh: Hermes Web UI 是一个功能完整的 Hermes Agent 管理仪表盘，支持多平台 AI 聊天会话管理、实时消息流、定时任务调度、使用量分析与成本追踪，以及 Telegram、Discord、Slack 等八种通信渠道的统一配置，提供本地 SQLite 会话存储与全局搜索能力。
repos.summary_en: Hermes Web UI is a full-featured dashboard for managing the Hermes Agent, offering multi-platform AI chat session control, real-time streaming, scheduled cron jobs, usage analytics with cost tracking, and unified configuration for 8 communication channels including Telegram, Discord, and Slack.

repos.description: 一个简单的本地网页界面，使用ChatTTS将文字合成为语音，同时支持对外提供API接口。A simple native web interface that uses ChatTTS to synthesize text into speech, along with support for external API interfaces.
repos.summary_zh: ChatTTS-ui 是一个本地网页界面，基于 ChatTTS 模型实现文字转语音功能，支持中英文及数字混合文本合成，并提供 API 接口供外部调用。支持 Windows 预打包版、Linux 容器及源码部署，兼容 CPU/GPU 加速（NVIDIA CUDA 或 AMD ROCm），首次运行自动下载模型文件。
repos.summary_en: ChatTTS-ui is a local web interface that uses the ChatTTS model to synthesize text into speech, supporting mixed Chinese-English text and numbers, with external API support. It offers pre-packaged Windows version, Linux container deployment, and source code setup, with CPU/GPU acceleration via NVIDIA CUDA or AMD ROCm, and automatic model download on first run.

repos.description: It's a new file uploader solution!
repos.summary_zh: WebUploader 是一个基于 HTML5 为主、Flash 为辅的现代文件上传组件，兼容 IE6+ 及移动端。支持大文件分片并发上传、图片预览压缩、拖拽粘贴添加文件，并提供 MD5 秒传与模块化扩展能力，显著提升上传效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: WebUploader is a modern file uploader built primarily on HTML5 with Flash fallback, supporting IE6+ and mobile browsers. It enables chunked concurrent uploads, image preview/compression, drag-and-drop/paste file addition, MD5 instant upload, and modular extensibility for enhanced performance and flexibility.

repos.description: an elegant efficient express mvvm framework
repos.summary_zh: Avalon2 是一个高效优雅的 MVVM 前端框架，支持双向数据绑定与组件化开发，具备优异的渲染性能与后端渲染能力。它兼容 IE6+，提供丰富的指令系统（如 ms-duplex、ms-if）和组件开发支持，适用于构建高性能单页应用（SPA）。
repos.summary_en: Avalon2 is an elegant and efficient MVVM framework for frontend development, featuring two-way data binding, componentization, and high-performance rendering. It supports server-side rendering, IE6+ compatibility, and provides a rich directive system (e.g., ms-duplex, ms-if) for building scalable single-page applications (SPAs).

repos.description: Making AJAX as easy as anchor tags
repos.summary_zh: Intercooler 是一个轻量级（6.74KB gzipped）的 AJAX 增强库，通过 HTML 属性即可实现类似锚标签的异步交互。它支持事件触发、进度指示、RESTful 依赖、AJAX 历史记录等功能，无需编写 JavaScript 即可构建现代 Web 应用，适用于渐进式增强现有项目。
repos.summary_en: Intercooler is a lightweight (6.74KB gzipped) library that enables AJAX functionality using HTML attributes, similar to anchor tags. It supports event triggers, progress indicators, RESTful dependencies, AJAX history, and more, allowing developers to build modern web apps with minimal JavaScript, ideal for incremental enhancement of existing applications.

repos.description: Enhanced MCP server for interactive user feedback and command execution in AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and Desktop Application) with intelligent environment detection and cross-platform compatibility.
repos.summary_zh: MCP Feedback Enhanced 是一个增强型 MCP 服务器，专为 AI 辅助开发设计，支持 Web UI 和跨平台桌面应用双界面，具备智能环境检测与反馈驱动工作流，可显著降低平台成本并提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: MCP Feedback Enhanced is an enhanced MCP server designed for AI-assisted development, featuring dual interface support (Web UI and cross-platform desktop app) with intelligent environment detection and feedback-driven workflows to reduce platform costs and boost development efficiency.

repos.description: 基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B等系列LLM的针对本地知识库的自动问答
repos.summary_zh: 本项目基于LangChain和ChatGLM-6B系列大模型，构建了一个针对本地知识库的自动问答Web应用。支持上传PDF、TXT、DOCX、MD等格式文档，结合多种Embedding模型实现语义检索，提供本地部署和云端体验，适用于私有知识问答、文档理解等场景。
repos.summary_en: This project builds a web-based QA system using LangChain and ChatGLM-6B series LLMs for local knowledge base queries. It supports uploading PDF, TXT, DOCX, MD files and integrates multiple embedding models for semantic retrieval, enabling private, offline document understanding and question answering.

repos.description: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology.
repos.summary_zh: RAG Web UI 是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）技术的智能对话系统，支持多格式文档管理与向量化处理，提供精准知识问答服务。系统具备前后端分离架构、分布式文件存储及高性能向量数据库（如 ChromaDB、Qdrant），支持 OpenAI、DeepSeek 及本地 Ollama 模型部署，适用于私有化部署与 API 集成场景。
repos.summary_en: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system powered by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology, enabling precise knowledge-based Q&A through document retrieval and LLM integration. It supports multi-format document ingestion, asynchronous processing, vectorization, and flexible LLM deployment (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), with a scalable backend architecture and OpenAPI for external access.

repos.description: splinter - python test framework for web applications
repos.summary_zh: Splinter 是一个简洁易用的 Python Web 应用自动化测试框架，提供直观的 API 支持浏览器交互自动化。它基于 Selenium 构建，支持多浏览器驱动，具备快速开发、灵活扩展和真实场景适配能力，适用于 Web 测试、爬虫及自动化任务。
repos.summary_en: Splinter is a simple and consistent Python framework for automating web applications. Built on Selenium, it offers an intuitive API for browser automation, supporting multiple drivers and real-world use cases. Ideal for testing, scraping, and UI automation with robust and flexible capabilities.

repos.description: Browser-native Office / PDF / CAD / archive viewer for internal web apps, with Vue, React, Svelte, jQuery, Web Components, and no server-side conversion.
repos.summary_zh: Flyfish File Viewer 是一款纯前端文件预览组件，支持 Office、PDF、CAD、压缩包等 208 种格式。它利用浏览器原生解析与渲染技术，无需后端转换，确保数据隐私与安全。支持 Vue、React 等主流框架，具备按需加载和私有化部署能力，适用于企业内部系统。
repos.summary_en: Flyfish File Viewer is a browser-native file preview component supporting 208 formats including Office, PDF, CAD, and archives. It leverages client-side parsing and rendering without server-side conversion, ensuring data privacy. Compatible with Vue, React, and other frameworks, it offers lazy loading and private deployment for enterprise internal systems.

repos.description: Simple and complete web UI framework to create web apps with Windows 8 Metro user interface, based on Bootstrap 2.
repos.summary_zh: BootMetro 是一个基于 Bootstrap 2 的 Web UI 框架，专为创建具有 Windows 8 Metro 风格界面的应用而设计，无需依赖 Windows 8 系统。它整合了 HTML5 Boilerplate 和 IcoMoon 图标库，提供 Metro 风格的布局、磁贴、通知、列表视图和翻转视图等组件，适用于企业内部网等现代 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: BootMetro is a web UI framework built on Bootstrap 2, designed to create web apps with the Windows 8 MetroUI style without requiring Windows 8. It integrates HTML5 Boilerplate and IcoMoon icons, offering Metro-styled layouts, tiles, toasts, list views, and flip views, ideal for modern intranet applications.

repos.description: 妈妈计划-众人拾柴火焰高
repos.summary_zh: 妈妈计划2（MAMA2）是一个开源项目，旨在解决MacBook观看在线视频时发热严重的问题，通过将Flash播放器替换为HTML5 Video实现。项目支持哔哩哔哩、优酷、土豆、芒果TV等主流视频网站，采用模块化架构，开发者可编写seeker脚本解析视频源地址。支持本地开发环境搭建，具备跨域请求、日志记录等工具函数，鼓励社区参与扩展支持网站。
repos.summary_en: MAMA2 is an open-source project designed to resolve overheating issues in MacBooks when watching online videos by replacing Flash players with HTML5 Video. It supports major platforms like Bilibili, Youku, Tudou, and more. The project uses a modular architecture where developers can write 'seeker' scripts to extract video URLs. It includes tools for AJAX, logging, and cross-domain requests, with a local development environment using Node.js and Gulp. Community contributions are encouraged to expand site support.

repos.description: WebSockets for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-socketio 是一个 BSD 许可的 Django 应用，通过集成 gevent-socketio 实现 WebSocket 支持，提供频道订阅、事件广播和信号式事件系统，支持实时通信与自动重载服务器，适用于需要实时交互的 Django 项目。
repos.summary_en: django-socketio is a BSD-licensed Django application that enables WebSocket support via gevent-socketio, offering channel-based subscriptions, event broadcasting, and a signals-like event system for real-time communication in Django projects.

repos.description: Standalone CliProxyAPI usage tracker with SQLite persistence and built-in dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: CPA Usage Keeper 是一款独立的 CLIProxyAPI 用量持久化与仪表盘服务，通过消费 Redis 队列将 CPA 用量数据写入 SQLite，并提供聚合 API 与内置 Web 仪表盘，支持按时间、模型、API Key 等多维度筛选，可视化展示请求量、Token 消耗、成本、缓存命中率及请求健康度。
repos.summary_en: CPA Usage Keeper is a standalone usage persistence and dashboard service for CLIProxyAPI. It consumes Redis usage events into SQLite, exposes aggregation APIs, and provides a built-in web dashboard for request volume, token usage, cost, cache hit rate, success rate, and multi-dimensional filtering by time, model, API key, and provider.

repos.description: 完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App | Completely free, open-source, collaborative accounting Web App
repos.summary_zh: Cent 是一款完全免费、开源的多人协作记账 Web App，基于 GitHub 仓库实现数据同步与版本控制，无需服务器即可跨平台实时协作。支持语音记账、AI 智能分析、多币种管理、地图可视化、周期记账等高级功能，采用纯前端 PWA 架构，数据完全自持于用户私有仓库，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Cent is a completely free, open-source collaborative accounting web app that uses GitHub repositories for data synchronization and version control, enabling real-time cross-platform collaboration without servers. It supports advanced features like voice记账, AI analysis, multi-currency management, map visualization, and recurring transactions. Built as a pure frontend PWA with data stored in user-owned private repositories for full privacy and security.

repos.description: A feature-rich, efficient text editor - Web Site
repos.summary_zh: Yu Writer Site 是一个功能丰富、高效的文本编辑器网站，提供现代化的写作体验。支持 Markdown 编辑、实时预览、多主题切换和本地存储，适用于内容创作者和开发者。项目采用轻量级架构，注重性能与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: Yu Writer Site is a feature-rich, efficient text editor web application offering a modern writing experience. It supports Markdown editing, live preview, multi-theme switching, and local storage, ideal for content creators and developers. Built with a lightweight architecture focused on performance and user experience.

repos.description: [EMNLP 2026] MobileGym: A Verifiable and Highly Parallel Simulation Platform for Mobile GUI Agent Research · 浏览器里运行的安卓模拟器 · Browser-hosted Android Simulator · Verifiable Evaluation · Scalable Online RL Training
repos.summary_zh: MobileGym 是一个基于浏览器的可验证、高并行移动 GUI Agent 研究仿真平台。它提供 28 个模拟应用和 416 个参数化任务模板，支持确定性亚毫秒级评测，单服务器可并行运行 256 个实例，并通过 Sim-to-Real 验证实现 +40.7 分真实设备性能提升。
repos.summary_en: MobileGym is a browser-hosted, verifiable and highly parallel simulation platform for mobile GUI agent research. It ships 28 simulated apps with 416 parameterized task templates, deterministic sub-millisecond judges, 256 parallel instances per server, and achieves +40.7 pt sim-to-real transfer on real devices.

repos.description: 😃 md 编辑器使用的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步到多个内容平台。
repos.summary_zh: COSE 是一款专为 Markdown 编辑器设计的浏览器扩展，支持一键将文章同步至 30+ 主流内容平台。核心亮点包括跨平台同步、自动登录检测、标签页分组管理，尤其针对微信公众号提供样式保留与草稿自动保存功能，全程本地运行保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: COSE is a browser extension designed for Markdown editors, enabling one-click article publishing to 30+ platforms. Key features include cross-platform sync, auto-login detection, tab grouping, and full CSS preservation for WeChat Official Accounts. Runs entirely locally with zero data collection.

repos.description: berserkJS 是新形态的前端测试自动化工具 + 页面性能分析工具 ，同时也是个使用 JS 语法控制的命令行浏览器。可用 JS 编写前端自动测试用例 + 页面性能分析用例。 想了解更多？看看连接中的文档吧~~
repos.summary_zh: berserkJS 是一款基于 Qt 的前端自动化测试与页面性能分析工具，支持无头浏览器模式运行主流测试框架，提供 DOM 操作、网络监控、屏幕捕获及性能指标采集功能，API 简洁且符合 W3C 标准，已在微博、Cisco、腾讯等企业落地应用。
repos.summary_en: berserkJS is a Qt-based frontend automation and performance analysis tool that supports headless browser testing with mainstream frameworks, offering DOM manipulation, network monitoring, screenshot capture, and performance metrics collection. Its W3C-compliant APIs are simple and production-proven in enterprises like Sina Weibo, Cisco, and Tencent.

repos.description: AI generate code
repos.summary_zh: needware.dev 是一个开源的 AI 驱动全栈开发平台，支持在浏览器中直接生成、预览和部署 Web 应用。通过多智能体系统，可将文本描述、截图或 URL 转化为完整代码，集成 Supabase 数据库、实时预览和代码编辑器，实现从想法到产品的全流程开发。
repos.summary_en: needware.dev is an open-source AI-powered full-stack development platform that generates, previews, and deploys web applications directly in the browser. It leverages a multi-agent system to transform text, screenshots, or URLs into functional code, with integrated Supabase database, real-time preview, and code editor for end-to-end development.

repos.description: 📁 轻盈优雅的 Web 原生 Cloudflare R2 桶文件管理器，一切皆在浏览器中完成。 | 📁 A lightweight, elegant, pure-browser Cloudflare R2 file manager. Everything happens right in your browser.
repos.summary_zh: R2 Web 是一款轻量级、优雅的纯浏览器 Cloudflare R2 文件管理器，无需构建或后端服务。它支持拖拽上传、图片压缩、多语言界面、深色模式及 PWA 桌面安装，所有操作均在客户端完成，直连 R2 API，保障数据安全。
repos.summary_en: R2 Web is a lightweight, elegant, pure-browser file manager for Cloudflare R2, with no build step or backend required. It supports drag-and-drop uploads, image compression, multi-language UI, dark mode, and PWA desktop installation—all client-side operations directly connecting to the R2 API.

repos.description: (Deprecated) WeUI Components with love of vue.js
repos.summary_zh: vue-weui 是一个已停止维护的 Vue 组件库，封装了 WeUI 0.4.0+ 的微信风格 UI 组件，完全解耦 CSS 样式，支持按需引入以优化包体积，适用于移动端 Web 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-weui is a deprecated Vue component library that encapsulates WeUI 0.4.0+ components for WeChat Web apps. It decouples CSS for full customization and supports selective imports to minimize bundle size.

repos.description: django-debug-toolbar in WebKit DevTools. Works fine with background Ajax requests and non-HTML responses.
repos.summary_zh: Django Debug Panel 将 Django Debug Toolbar 集成至 WebKit DevTools，支持 AJAX 请求和 HTML 响应外的调试场景，专为单页应用和 AJAX 密集型项目设计，提供浏览器内实时调试能力。
repos.summary_en: Django Debug Panel embeds the Django Debug Toolbar into WebKit DevTools, enabling debugging for AJAX requests and non-HTML responses. Ideal for single-page and AJAX-heavy applications, it offers in-browser real-time debugging.

repos.description: 🐵 A Streamlit image-to-vector tool powered by the Vecto engine — upload PNG/JPG and get clean, editable SVG with live side-by-side preview. 基于 Vecto 引擎的图片转 SVG 工具:上传位图自动矢量化,分割视图对比,导出 SVG/PNG。
repos.summary_zh: 悟空图片转SVG工具是一款基于Streamlit的开源位图矢量化Web应用。底层采用Vecto引擎，支持上传PNG/JPG等格式自动转为可编辑SVG。提供原图/矢量/分割视图三合一对比、调色板与风格参数实时调节，中英双语，可云端部署或本地运行。
repos.summary_en: Goku Image to SVG Tool is an open-source web app built on Streamlit for bitmap vectorization. Powered by the Vecto engine, it converts PNG/JPG images into clean, editable SVG files with real-time parameter tuning and a three-view slider comparison. Features bilingual UI, cloud deployment support, and zero command-line required.

repos.description: AI 图像编辑 Web 应用，使用 **FLUX.1 Kontext [pro]** 前沿模型提供强大的图像编辑功能，支持Stripe支付，注册登录，积分系统等，代码100%开源。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Next.js 15 构建的现代化 AI 图像编辑 Web 应用，集成前沿 FLUX.1 Kontext Pro 模型，支持智能编辑、背景移除、多格式输出及 Stripe 支付，提供完整的用户认证、积分系统和国际化支持，代码完全开源。
repos.summary_en: A modern AI image editing web app built with Next.js 15, powered by the cutting-edge FLUX.1 Kontext Pro model. Features intelligent editing, background removal, multi-format support, Stripe payments, user authentication, points system, and full internationalization, with 100% open-source code.

repos.description: top, but for the HTTP endpoints on your host — a live dashboard of the most active plaintext HTTP endpoints, right in the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: httpinspect 是一款基于 eBPF 的终端实时监控工具，类比 top 命令，直接在内核 TC 层抓取网卡明文 HTTP 请求，按流量、速率和延迟排序展示活跃端点。无需代理、Sidecar 或修改应用代码，支持回环接口监控本地微服务通信，提供 p50/p95/max 延迟、状态码分布及每秒请求数等详细指标。
repos.summary_en: httpinspect is an eBPF-powered terminal live dashboard that ranks plaintext HTTP endpoints by traffic, rate, and latency — like top, but for HTTP. It attaches at the TC layer to read packets directly off the wire with no proxy, sidecar, or application changes. It covers loopback traffic for local microservice chatter and surfaces per-endpoint latency percentiles, status-code mix, and req/s sparklines in a TUI.

repos.description: Local-first dashboard for observing Claude Code usage, cost, sessions, and time.
repos.summary_zh: Lumo是一款本地优先的桌面应用，专为开发者设计，用于追踪Claude Code的使用情况。它通过本地SQLite数据库收集并可视化成本、令牌消耗、会话时长和编码时间等关键指标，提供直观的仪表盘视图，无需云端账户或数据外传，完全在用户机器上运行。
repos.summary_en: Lumo is a local-first desktop application that tracks Claude Code usage by collecting telemetry data locally. It provides real-time dashboards for cost, tokens, sessions, and coding time using a native Tauri + Next.js UI, storing everything in a local SQLite database without requiring cloud accounts or external data transmission.

repos.description: Building WebApp in Android way.
repos.summary_zh: Jndroid 是一个 JavaScript 框架，允许开发者以 Android 原生应用的方式构建 WebApp。它通过提供类似 Android 的 UI 组件（如 TextView）和 setContentView 等 API，简化了 Web 应用的开发流程，适用于需要跨平台或移动端体验优化的场景。
repos.summary_en: Jndroid is a JavaScript framework enabling WebApp development in an Android-like manner. It provides Android-style UI components (e.g., TextView) and APIs like setContentView, simplifying cross-platform mobile web app development with native-like structure.

repos.description: A minimalist, terminal-style new tab page for your browser.
repos.summary_zh: Neko-Tab 是一款极简终端风格的浏览器新标签页扩展，基于 React + TypeScript + Vite 构建。核心亮点是键盘优先的命令面板（Ctrl+K），集成模糊搜索、URL 别名、内置计算器、标签页搜索、多搜索引擎切换及 AI 命令解释器（支持 OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）。AI 模块可学习浏览历史、智能解析自然语言指令（如打开多个应用），并支持基于历史记录的问答与日志保存。提供 22+ 主题、自定义 ASCII 艺术和便签本功能。
repos.summary_en: Neko-Tab is a minimalist, terminal-style browser new tab extension built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Its keyboard-first command palette (Ctrl+K) unifies fuzzy search, URL aliases, a built-in calculator, tab switching, multi-engine search, and an AI command interpreter (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini). The AI learns from browsing history, resolves natural-language navigation, answers history-based Q&A, and saves summaries to a journal. Features 22+ themes, custom ASCII art, and a scratchpad.

repos.description: Local-first desktop API client built for developers and AI agents
repos.summary_zh: Voleeo 是一款面向 AI 时代的本地优先桌面 API 客户端，原生支持 HTTP、gRPC、WebSocket 和 GraphQL 四大协议。内置 MCP Server，允许 AI 智能体直接读写工作区、发起请求与管理环境。具备 AES-256-GCM 加密、OAuth 2.0 等全链路认证、Git 版本控制、OpenAPI/Postman 导入及插件扩展能力，零遥测、无云端锁定。
repos.summary_en: Voleeo is a local-first desktop API client built for the AI era, natively supporting HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket, and GraphQL in a single app. It doubles as an MCP server, enabling AI agents to read, create, and execute requests directly from chat. Features include AES-256-GCM encryption, full auth suites (OAuth 2.0, SigV4, etc.), Git-based collection versioning, OpenAPI/Postman imports, plugin extensibility, and zero telemetry with no cloud lock-in.

repos.description: A skill for coding agents that build, review, and refactor Web UI that should be easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate.
repos.summary_zh: 为AI编码代理提供的Web UI设计技能，指导构建、审查与重构前端界面，使其对人类、屏幕阅读器、浏览器自动化、Playwright测试及AI代理更友好。核心聚焦语义HTML、清晰状态、稳定定位器与可复现URL模式，附带分级审查报告，助力提升前端可访问性与自动化兼容性。
repos.summary_en: A skill for coding agents to build, review, and refactor Web UI that is easier for humans, screen readers, browser automation, Playwright tests, and AI agents to understand and operate. It focuses on semantic HTML, clear state, stable locators, and reproducible URL patterns, providing severity-graded review reports to enhance accessibility and automation compatibility.

repos.description: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 浏览器扩展，旨在提升用户阅读微信公众号文章的体验。通过自动生成文章的结构化目录，让您轻松了解文章结构、快速导航到感兴趣的部分，并在阅读长文时保持位置感知。
repos.summary_zh: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 扩展，专为优化电脑端阅读微信公众号长文体验而设计。核心功能包括自动生成结构化目录、图片放大预览、链接智能识别与跳转，以及阅读位置实时追踪，显著提升信息获取效率与视觉舒适度。
repos.summary_en: WeChat Reader Enhancer is a Chrome extension designed to improve the reading experience of WeChat Official Account articles on desktop. It features auto-generated structured table of contents, image zoom-in preview, URL recognition and clickable linking, and real-time reading position tracking, significantly enhancing content navigation and visual comfort.

repos.description: A calm, local-first Chrome MV3 new tab dashboard
repos.summary_zh: 乔木Tab 是一款基于 Chrome MV3 的本地优先新标签页仪表盘，将浏览器首页替换为安静、美观的个人工作台。集成时间显示、待办事项、常用网站、最近访问、便签、天气和音乐等功能，支持本地搜索、网页搜索与 AI 入口切换。核心数据默认存储于本机，无需注册登录，注重隐私保护，界面设计克制且中文体验友好，适合追求高效与专注的用户。
repos.summary_en: Qiaomu Tab is a calm, local-first Chrome MV3 new tab dashboard that transforms your browser's homepage into a minimalist personal workspace. It integrates time display, to-do lists, frequently used sites, recent history, sticky notes, weather, and music—all rendered locally without requiring an account. With support for local, web, and AI search, it emphasizes privacy, performance, and a distraction-free experience tailored for Chinese users.
